column1: # Narration for the demo, one line per row, pipe separated:
#   <second on the assembled timeline>|<words>
# The assembled file is three pieces: the HyperFrames explainer (0-25s), the walkthrough of the
# deployed site (25-466s), and the HyperFrames end card (466-478s). This is the long cut: every step of
# the case, every wallet confirmation and every explorer page is on screen, and the narration talks
# through the flow rather than over it. Starts are placed against the screen map measured from the
# shipped file itself, at one frame every three seconds:
#     0.0 -  25.0  explainer: the idea, the mechanic, the tolerances, the proof
#    25.0 -  62.0  the landing page, scrolled whole
#    62.0 -  72.0  the overview: the bond, the held bonuses, what needs a decision
#    72.0 - 135.0  the case opens, and the wallet is funded
#   135.0 - 200.0  the lie size, and the false print signed for
#   200.0 - 275.0  the loan, and the real price printed
#   275.0 - 340.0  the liquidation, and the hold
#   340.0 - 420.0  the second print, upheld, and the debt settled
#   420.0 - 432.0  the explorer
#   432.0 - 445.0  prove a price
#   445.0 - 456.0  the case list
#   456.0 - 466.0  the landing page again, closing
#   466.0 - 478.0  end card: what is live, and where to look
# Numbers are spelled as they are spoken, there is no marketing vocabulary, and every claim is one the
# viewer can check on screen in the same shot. Only rows that begin with a digit are read. The rate is
# left at the voice's own pace, and build_narration.sh refuses to build a track whose line outlasts the
# section it is talking about.
0.4|A feed's price decides what a loan is worth.
5.4|The bonus a liquidation pays is computed from that price.
10.9|Two sources have to agree within five per cent.
15.7|The bonus is held for five minutes. The debt is not.
20.6|Anyone can challenge. The contract decides.
27.0|This is the landing page: what is held back, and why.
36.0|The liquidator's profit is held for five minutes. The debt is not.
44.0|The landing page sets out what the contract checks, and what it holds.
51.0|Five rules, each one a predicate over state the contract already has.
57.5|Then the contracts, and the tests behind them.
64.0|The dashboard, reading the chain: the bond a feed carries, and what needs a decision.
74.0|A visitor can run the whole case. The page says what the wallet needs first: test gas.
82.0|Funding the wallet is the visitor's own transaction.
95.0|The feed's operator runs on the server, so a visitor never needs that key.
103.0|Every step here is a transaction the visitor signs.
110.0|The case opens with the feed's honest print, and the peer's print beside it.
120.0|Step one done. The page keeps the wallet's shortfall on screen until it is fixed.
127.0|The visitor chooses how far the feed will lie. Eight per cent is enough to be provable.
139.0|The false print is a transaction, so the wallet asks first.
152.0|The request names the contract it calls, and the fee, before anything is signed.
182.0|Once printed, the page reads the print back from the chain.
192.0|Eight per cent off a second source is over the five per cent tolerance, so it is provable.
205.0|Next, the loan. The collateral is escrowed until the case ends.
220.0|That is two transactions: an approval, then the loan itself.
240.0|The position is live, and the collateral sits with the protocol.
248.0|The collateral and the debt are read from the position, not typed in.
258.0|Each transaction has its own receipt, and a step completes only when it lands.
268.0|The wallet reports it confirmed.
300.0|The feed has now printed the real price and the false one.
312.0|The contract holds both, with the round each one belongs to.
322.0|Printing is free. Pricing is not: a band needs four prints behind it.
340.0|The market liquidates on the false print, and the bonus is held instead of paid.
352.0|The hold runs five minutes, and the challenge window with it.
370.0|The feed prints again, and the run page tracks what the bond is carrying.
392.0|The run page keeps every step's transaction, and its result.
398.0|Settling is one more transaction, signed the same way.
404.0|Upheld: the print contradicted the record, so the borrower is made whole.
411.0|The case is closed. The collateral is back with the borrower.
415.5|Every transaction links to the explorer, where it can be read.
424.0|The transaction page: the call, the logs, and the block it landed in.
434.0|The prove page lists the bonuses held and every verdict reached.
445.0|The case list shows all seven cases, each with the bond it paid.
458.0|Prices you can check, and a record you can read.
466.0|Six contracts on Arbitrum Sepolia, with no owner.
472.0|Every number on it is read from the chain.
